title: Keep a newly opened retained child across snapshots before workspace render commits
outcome: An accepted retained-child open is not lost if a snapshot arrives before React commits the workspace update; retained card-open also synchronizes project selection consistently.
acceptance: A deterministic test opens a retained child, applies a snapshot before the workspace render, and verifies the resulting transcript tab remains open.
The retained-child card-open path synchronizes project selection consistently with the live-session path.
